description: This file implements the 'Returns' controller for a user account in an OpenCart e-commerce platform. It manages viewing a list of product returns, viewing detailed information about a specific return, adding new return requests, saving return data, and displaying return history.

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: Controller class handling product return-related actions for a user's account, including listing returns, viewing details, adding new returns, saving, and viewing history.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays a list of returns for the logged-in user, paginated, with breadcrumbs and navigation controls.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Shows detailed information for a specific return, including status, comments, and history; redirects if not found or not authorized.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Prepares the form for creating a new return request, pre-filling form data if an order and product are specified.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles form submission to create a new return record; validates input and captcha, then redirects to a success page.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Displays a confirmation page after successfully creating a return.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Displays the history of status updates and comments for a specific return.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Fetches and renders paginated history data for a specific return.
